interaction.limits: Post-mount native canvas capture observes actual trusted events; readPixels observes every WebGL2 context including Deck offscreen. Initial activation is recorded separately; repeated recognized movement is the suppressed-hover interval. This actual UI checks Escape and public placement cancellation; other style/context/deactivate paths retain focused unit coverage rather than a new product framework.

method.method: Original move counts and position formula; original event timestamps were not recorded, so commands are spaced uniformly over the original4second interval.

limits: Original acceptance did not capture MVPs or input timestamps. These are reconstructed inputs using original move counts/formula uniformly spaced over four seconds, not the original recorded trajectory.
Both replays already meet frame target. ReadPixels reduction is causal on the four exactly matched start/end Orbit cameras; it does not prove the original intermittent p95 misses cured.
Early document input observer produced no input events; its whileHeld fields are invalid and excluded. Final post-mount trusted-event and offscreen-context witness supplies the held/release gate.
Plan paused ink affine matches; Plan playing differs by about0.22devicepixel because native Pan inertia changes timing. Pan readPixels stays1before/after, so no native-Pan lease is claimed.
Diagnostic elapsed intervals, not utilization; include potential idle awaiting CPU commands. Draw/resolve separately measured; clear/full-screen composite excluded.
Marginal p95values must not be added into a combinedp95. These are a different matched-Home path from the original failed acceptance poses.

historicalLimitations: Previous20a acceptance retained four full-layer p95misses33.3–33.4ms. They are not discarded or attributed solely to Deck hover, live status, or a background browser.
Current32windows all pass frame-p95target but include one69ms longtask. Its cause is not profiled or claimed fixed; no repeat was used to replace it.
One old paused agent IABtab was present unchanged during lease A/B, then root closed it before final qualification. No background-causality claim.

Default source delivery includes full immutable source; hidden mesh layers are prepared only when requested. Full-layer runs enable alldeclared layers through actual UI and verify the new VBO coverage keys.
Typed renderbuffers/Canvas backing stores are inventories, not process RSS or driver total. Optional diagnostic RSS is own Chrome descendant mappings, not PSS and not production-servermemory.
Local vector/reference proxy uses read-only productionGET/HEAD. No production Workspace/RunAPI is invoked. One machine/browser/profile; no WAN/constraineddevice assurance.
